staff.name: Fr. Mark McCormick
staff.duties: Fr. Mark is serving as Head Pastor of St. Thérèse the Little Flower & the St. Carlo Acutis Catholic Student Center, serving alongside Fr. Todd VanderMay.
staff.bio: Fr. Mark was born in Rapid City, SD, and grew up in the Black Hills. He attended St. Martin's College in Lacey, WA, and graduated with a degree in Philosophy. He then attended Mount Angel Seminary in St. Benedict, OR, where he earned a Master of Divinity degree. Fr. Mark was ordained to the priesthood on May 30, 1999, and has served in various parishes throughout the Diocese of Rapid City.

staff.name: Kevin Baltzer
titles: Director of Evangelization & Adult & Family Formation
staff.duties:
I'm in charge of Adult & Family Ministry, which is being taught on Wednesdays — see the "Faith Formation" tab for more information.
I'm also the staff designated IT guy who built this new website and will keep it running and updated!
staff.bio:
Growing up on a farm southwest of Huron, SD, I earned my Chemical Engineering degree from South Dakota Mines before spending three years as a full-time missionary with FOCUS Catholic. Today, I serve as the Director of Evangelization and Adult & Family Formation at St. Thérèse the Little Flower Parish in Rapid City. Driven by a love for classical learning and Catholic youth formation, 

I currently live in the Rapid Valley area with my wife Katie and daughter Lucia.
